user.title: Fluvy
user.description: Installs Fluvy's theme, cards and settings panel. There is nothing to configure.

frontend_missing.message: Fluvy's frontend files are missing from custom_components/fluvy/frontend. Reinstall Fluvy through HACS (or run `pnpm build` in a development checkout), then restart Home Assistant.

legacy_yaml.title: Remove Fluvy's old lines from configuration.yaml
legacy_yaml.description:
Fluvy is now an integration and registers its panel and its module itself. Remove these from configuration.yaml (keep `frontend: themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes`), check the configuration and restart Home Assistant when convenient:

{lines}

theme_not_loaded.title: Fluvy's theme is not loaded

resources_yaml_mode.title: Add Fluvy's dashboard resource
resources_yaml_mode.description:
Your dashboard resources are managed in YAML, so Fluvy cannot register its own. Add this under `lovelace: resources:` in configuration.yaml and reload the browser:

```yaml
  - url: {url}
    type: module
```

Fluvy already loads on every page; this resource lets dashboards load it before they render.
